==Active Ability: The Extinction==
[[File:Usurper (Founder) Passive.png|left|103x103px]]
{{PAGENAME}} can spawn 10 Wall Titans and 1 Usurper (Founder) upon using the ability. All titans spawned are capable of damaging Flying and Boss enemies. 


* Duration: N/A (it varies on the HP of the enemies and the timing)
* Cooldown: 480s

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
*He is currently the most expensive unit in the game, racking up by {{Yen|100,000}} upon deployment, and with {{Yen|1,050,000}} when maxed.
*As of Update 19.0.0, Usurper (Founder) is now unobtainable as his raid has been removed.
